bibl.title: Three Deluxe Horoscopes
bibl.seg: 141.4 P. Berol. Inv. 21347 P. Ryl. Inv. Greek Add. 1132 P. Yale Inv. 4265 (A)
Michael W. Zellmann-Rohrer, Three Deluxe Horoscopes.
bibl.note: Edition of three "deluxe" (or "elaborate") horoscopes for births in the second and third centuries CE, one probably dated to the reign of Gallus. Each offers indirect reflections of astrological interpretation of the horoscopic data, including the classification of planets, zodiac signs, their parts, and of additional objects such as the cardinal points and paranatellonta. - 1. P. Berol. 21347. Egypt, 2nd c. CE. - 2. P. CtYBR [= P. Yale] 4265 (A). Egypt, late 2nd - 1st half of the 3rd c. CE. - 3. P. Ryl. Greek Add. 1132. Hermopolite?, 24 Nov. 252 CE? (after).
